About Ahern Maritime

Dedicated to What's Below the Waterline

Ahern Maritime is a specialist boat bottom cleaning service based on Long Island's North Shore. We focus exclusively on underwater hull maintenance — because a clean bottom means better performance, lower fuel costs, and a longer life for your vessel.

Marine growth like barnacles, algae, and slime can increase drag by up to 40%, costing you speed and money every time you head out. Our divers keep your hull in peak condition so you can focus on what matters — being on the water.

What We Do

Professional Hull Services

Every service is performed by experienced divers using professional-grade equipment and environmentally responsible methods.

🤿

Bottom Cleaning

Thorough removal of barnacles, algae, and marine growth from your hull using non-abrasive techniques that protect your bottom paint and gelcoat.

🔍

Hull Inspection

Detailed visual inspection of your hull, zincs, and underwater hardware. We'll report any issues before they become costly problems.

Service Area

Long Island's North Shore

Based out of Cold Spring Harbor. We serve marinas, yacht clubs, and private docks throughout the North Shore.
